class.name: Awakened Cleric Class
lore: Choose the Awakened Cleric Class

skills.name: Divine Revelation
lore: You periodically glow as divine will descends upon you. While under
Divine Revelation, your next basic attack becomes a light wave that
stuns enemies and heals allies. The revelation is consumed upon
activation and returns after a cooldown.
🗡 {damage} Damage
🕗 {stunduration}s Stun Duration
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Sacred Combo
lore: Execute a chain of sacred attacks:
1st Strike: A left diagonal mace swing, pushing enemies to the side.
2nd Strike: A right diagonal swing follows, pushing enemies to the other side.
3rd Strike: Dash forward and bash enemies with your mace.
4th Strike: Smash the ground with your mace, releasing a holy pulse that damages
enemies and heals nearby allies.
🗡 {damage} Damage
♥️ {heal} Heal
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Cruciform Judgement
lore: Release a massive X-shaped holy wave that advances extremely slowly.
Enemies caught within are struck repeatedly as it passes through.
When the wave reaches its end, it detonates in divine light,
stunning all affected enemies.
🗡 {damage} Damage
🕗 {stunduration}s Stun Duration
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Orbs Of Benediction
lore: Several luminous spirit orbs descend slowly from the sky around you.
You and your allies may consume the orbs to restore health, the
light dissolving upon contact.
♥️ {heal} Heal
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Bell Of Absolution
lore: Summon a towering holy bell that can be struck up to three times.
The first strike releases a resonant soundwave that heals allies.
The second strike spreads purifying waves that cleanse debuffs from
allies and slow enemies. The third strike sends radiant particles
toward each ally, granting a single instance of divine
invincibility.
♥️ {heal} Heal
🕗 {slowduration}s Slow Duration
🕗 {invincibilityduration}s Invincibility Duration
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Sanctuary Beam
lore: A vertical beam of holy light descends at the targeted location. A
sacred ring forms at its impact point, continuously healing and
granting resistance to allies, while dealing damage and slowing
enemies within.
🗡 {damage} Damage
🕗 {slowduration}s Slow Duration
♥️ {heal} Heal
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Divine Cathedral
lore: Unfurl radiant wings and ascend in spiritual form, freely flying
across the battlefield. Throughout the duration, streams of holy
particles automatically seek out allies, providing constant minor
healing. Meanwhile, a massive holy cross structure manifests upon
the ground. Beneath enemies, clock-like divine sigils slowly rotate,
reducing movement speed and inflicting weakness. Allies standing
within the cathedral gain increased speed and strength.
♥️ {heal} Heal
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
